_help: Linux/macOS only: .ico viewer built from netpng (github.com/tsnomura/netpng). Pipes the icon's largest size through ico2png into pngview, which shows it in its own window (wheel zooms, left-drag pans, Space cycles zoom, Enter re-centers, 0 resets, s saves a copy, c copies to the clipboard, q/Esc closes). Needs ico2png and pngview on PATH, and ico-view.sh next to this file, executable; edit <LAUNCHERS_DIR> to the launchers folder path shown in Preferences → Launchers. Waydir ignores every key starting with "_".
name: View in pngview
